p1.text: Applications are now being accepted for the following courses: Beginners and intermediate Japanese, beginners Polish, intermediate to advanced Russian, an introduction to Chinese culture and a Musical Theatre Performance Workshop. The Language Department, with the exception of the Musical Theatre Performance Workshop, which is being run by the Drama Society, is running all of the above courses. Application forms can be obtained from the Faculty of Arts Administration Office. Please note: the closing date for receipt of applications is March 10th. All fees are outlined in the application form and 10% deposits are due in advance of the commencement of each course.

p2.text: Many organisations find it beneficial to employ students during the summer. Permanent staff often wish to take their own holidays over this period. Furthermore, it is not uncommon for companies to experience peak workloads in the summer and so require extra staff. Summer employment also attracts students who may return as well qualified recruits to an organisation when they have completed their education. Ensuring that the students learn as much as possible about the organisation encourages their interest in working on a permanent basis. Organisations pay students on a fixed rate without the usual entitlement to paid holidays or sick leave.

p3.text: Guidelines regarding the payment of suppliers are stored in the Finance Unit. Those wishing to purchase from suppliers must adhere to the following rules. Firstly, a request for a quote must be issued to at least three suppliers which will detail the unit cost, delivery time and total cost of the purchase. Only budget holders are permitted to decide upon what quote should be accepted. Once the quote has been accepted, a purchase order is issued by the Finance Unit to the relevant supplier. The invoice should be sent directly to the Finance Unit upon receipt by the budget holder where it is compared to the Purchase Order for accuracy.

p4.text: The computer system is limited in the number of reports it can generate. The Workflow Report was designed to allow the manager to print or view the workflow activity of the department. Department managers must have "senior access" rights in order to generate this report. The System Administrator and four other staff only are permitted to give users access rights to the computer system. "Viewing Access" rights are one of three sets of rights available to users. Reports have to be designed by computer programmers who have "report writing" access rights. All reports with the exception of the Security Breach Report are compatible with the department’s word processing computer package. The Security Breach Report can be generated to show the security password of the user that breached the system. All staff are advised to keep their password secret and not to disclose it to any third party. The System Usage report and the Security Breach report can only be generated by the System Administrator

questions.text: There are no courses available for those who wish to study Russian.
questions.explanation: Intermediate to advanced Russian is offered.

questions.text: The Faculty of Arts Administration office only holds information on courses run by the Language Department and the Drama Society.
questions.explanation: The office supplies application forms, but nothing says what other information it holds.

questions.text: Full fees are due in advance of the course start date.
questions.explanation: Only a 10% deposit is due before the course starts.

questions.text: Applications will be accepted for all courses until March 10th.
questions.explanation: The closing date for applications is March 10th.

questions.text: It is possible that permanent staff who are on holiday can have their work carried out by students
questions.explanation: Permanent staff often take holidays in summer, when students are employed.

questions.text: Students in summer employment are given the same paid holiday benefit as Permanent staff.
questions.explanation: Students aren't entitled to paid holidays.

questions.text: Students are subject to the organisations’ standard disciplinary and grievance procedures.
questions.explanation: Disciplinary and grievance procedures aren't mentioned.

questions.text: Some companies have more work to do in summer when students are available for vacation work.
questions.explanation: Companies often have peak summer workloads and take on students.

questions.text: There are certain rules, which must be adhered to by those wishing to purchase from suppliers.
questions.explanation: Anyone purchasing from suppliers must follow set rules.

questions.text: Whoever requests the quote has the responsibility of deciding which quote will be accepted.
questions.explanation: Only budget holders can decide which quote to accept, not whoever requests it.

questions.text: The budget holder is generally the office manager.
questions.explanation: The passage doesn't say who budget holders are.

questions.text: Suppliers should send invoices directly to the Finance Unit.
questions.explanation: The invoice goes to the budget holder first, who then sends it to the Finance Unit.

questions.text: Only the System Administrator and the staff of the System Administrator are permitted to give users access rights to the computer system.
questions.explanation: Four other staff can give access rights, but we don't know whether they are the System Administrator's staff.

questions.text: All department managers have their own security password.
questions.explanation: All staff are told to keep their own password secret, which implies each user — managers included — has one. The source key was True; some readings differ.

flag.note: Alternative reading: Cannot say. The passage implies users have passwords ('All staff are advised to keep their password secret'), but never states that every department manager has one, or that it is their own rather than shared. 'All' is a strong claim the passage doesn't support.

questions.text: The departments word processing packages can be used to generate all the department reports.
questions.explanation: The Security Breach Report isn't compatible with the word processing package.
